notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Personal Tutor by paying {U}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it on top of your library.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.
